text: Accepted archive tests cover granularity, structure and inbox-folder options, then separately verify editing another identity leaves default-identity archive preferences unchanged. Production archive acceptance writes three fields on the supplied identity. Preserve both the option matrix and identity ownership checks; the test helper synthesizes Enter and also explicitly accepts the dialog, so it is not a keyboard-only acceptance proof. These observations are scoped to the cited accepted source and historical changes. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline discussion remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run.
